description: Four voltage processors: each one attenuates and offsets its input, can sample and hold it or compare it against zero on a clock, then slews it linearly, exponentially or as an envelope follower

params.text: Picks what that channel does: S&H holds the input value at each rising clock edge, COMP puts out 10V at each rising clock edge while the input is above 0V and 0V otherwise, OFF passes it straight on
Attenuates or amplifies the input of that channel, from 0 to 2 times
Adds a constant voltage to the input of that channel, -5V to +5V
Picks how the output of that channel approaches its target: LIN at a constant rate, EXP exponentially, ENV following the envelope of the input
Sets the speed at which the follower of that channel moves toward its target
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change

inputs.text: The signal processed by that channel
A rising edge here drives the sample and hold or the comparison of that channel
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number

outputs.text: The processed signal of that channel

notes: a modulation input does nothing until its slot is assigned: press the slot's button, then move the control the slot should change; the screen reads MOVE A CONTROL TO ASSIGN IT meanwhile
